r13_contract.comparisonModel: IF ship_operates_in_polar_waters = true, THEN chapter_11_1_applicable = true when (ship_type = fishing_vessel AND length_overall_m >= 24) OR (ship_type = pleasure_yacht AND gross_tonnage >= 300 AND engaged_in_trade = false) OR (ship_type = cargo_ship AND 300 <= gross_tonnage < 500).

test_cases.rationale: Polar-water fishing vessel exactly at 24 m boundary is applicable.
Polar-water fishing vessel below 24 m is outside Chapter 11-1.
Polar-water non-trading pleasure yacht exactly at 300 GT boundary.
Pleasure yacht below 300 GT is outside Chapter 11-1.
Pleasure yacht engaged in trade is outside this Chapter 11-1 branch.
Polar-water cargo ship exactly at 300 GT lower boundary.
Polar-water cargo ship below 500 GT upper boundary.
Cargo ship at 500 GT is outside the <500 GT branch.
Ship not operating in polar waters is outside Chapter 11-1.
Other ship type is outside the three Chapter 11-1 alternatives.
